name: caveman-agent
description: Open-source Caveman Agent SDK, Caveman Harness, Session Protocol, Evals, and React hooks.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @caveman-ai/protocol build && pnpm --filter @caveman-ai/harness build && pnpm --filter @caveman-ai/agent build && pnpm --filter @caveman-ai/evals build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @caveman-ai/protocol test && pnpm --filter @caveman-ai/harness test && pnpm --filter @caveman-ai/agent test && pnpm --filter @caveman-ai/evals test && pnpm --filter @caveman-ai/react test && pnpm test:examples
